description: This file contains controller functions for user authentication and password management in a Node.js backend, including signin, signup, forgotPassword, and resetPassword functionalities, utilizing JWT, bcrypt, nodemailer, and crypto modules.

methods.name: signin
methods.description: Authenticates a user by email and password, generates a JWT token, and retrieves user profile.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Registers a new user with hashed password, creates a user record, and generates a JWT token.

methods.name: forgotPassword
methods.description: Generates a password reset token, saves it to the user record, and sends a reset email.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Resets the user's password using a valid reset token and updates the user record.
